scope: Local production JavaScript fix, compatibility/security tests, configuration and source-notice review. No public deployment or container rebuild.
compatibility: Application uses static file serving over a fixed dist/web root. Both wildcard serving and glob-enumerated routes were tested, including HEAD, byte ranges, missing assets and root escape denial.

container.status: deferred by user after engine startup was blocked
container.reason: Docker Linux-engine named pipe unavailable before and after a normal startup attempt. Startup command stalled and was cancelled. No reset or deletion.
container.baseline: 2026-10-28; images are not rebuilt with these fixes and must not be described as current clean scans

proxyAdvisory.config: Caddy admin off; only health denial and reverse_proxy routes; no configured public JWK-processing service. Scoped review, not exhaustive reachability proof.

distribution.binaries: not distributed; corresponding-source package remains required before image/tool distribution

publication: Reviewed source follow-up for anishsharma1356/playable-moments; no binaries or private raw reports are included. Remote publication is recorded separately.
